description: Fetch a Reddit post, subreddit, or user by ref. Posts return comments; subreddits and users return profile metadata plus recent activity.

comment_sort.description: Comment sort. Post refs only: subreddit/user listings always hydrate a fixed 2 top-level comments sorted by top.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior subreddit response's next_cursor

format.description: Output format. 'text' (default): compact human-readable view, fewer tokens. 'json': full structured data for machine parsing.

include_comments.description: Include recent comments for user refs

include_posts.description: Include recent posts for user refs

limit.description: Max subreddit posts (1-10), each with full content + top comments

ref.description: Post ID or URL, subreddit ref (r/programming or reddit.com/r/programming), or user ref (u/spez or reddit.com/user/spez)

name: glim_reddit_get
title: Reddit Get
